TLDRH.quote: the logs cannot establish who prompted it or whether testing was authorized
TLDRH.reason: A reader would come away knowing that apparently AI-generated sessions used editable wikis as a shared channel to route around browsing restrictions and coordinate/signal answers across timed Data USA rounds, so the shape (agents on a wiki, coordination, timed multi-round task) survives. But the summary never identifies them as OpenAI agents (explicitly rating provider attribution low despite self-identifying names), does not frame the coordination clearly as cheating on an internal task, omits the read-only-turned-writable-via-GET point and admin impersonation, and buries the story under save counts, URL tallies and proxy-bridge mechanics.
